name: std::permutable

declarations.code:
template <class I>

concept permutable =

    std::forward_iterator<I> &&

    std::indirectly_movable_storable<I, I> &&

    std::indirectly_swappable<I, I>;

intro: The concept permutable refines std::forward_iterator by adding requirements for reordering through moves and swaps.

sections.title: Semantic requirements
sections.text: I models permutable only if all concepts it subsumes are modeled.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: An int pointer iterates over {3, 7} and satisfies permutable.
